title: What's Your Content Production Score?
subtitle: 6 questions. 2 minutes. Find out if you're a content machine or a content hostage.
captureHeadline: Before we judge your content workflow...
captureSubtext: Tell us where to send your score. We promise not to add you to a 47-email nurture sequence. (We automated that away years ago.)

questions.text: How many pieces of content do you publish per week?
questions.subtext: Posts, reels, videos, blogs, newsletters — all of it.
questions.tooltip: The top 1% of creators publish 20+ pieces per week. Before you panic, most of them automated 80% of it. That's the secret no one talks about.

questions.text: How long does it take you to create ONE piece of content?
questions.subtext: From idea to published. Be honest — include the 45 minutes you spent picking a font.
questions.tooltip: The industry average is 3-4 hours per blog post and 2 hours per social video. AI-assisted creators do the same in 20-30 minutes. Same quality. Less existential dread.

questions.text: What eats most of your content time?
questions.subtext: Pick the one that just made you sigh.
questions.tooltip: 83% of creators say editing is their biggest time sink. The irony: editing is the most automatable part of the entire pipeline. The robots are literally better at cutting silence and color grading than you are. Sorry.

options.label: Writing captions and copy
options.subtitle: The worst part and you know it

questions.text: Do you repurpose content across platforms?
questions.subtext: One video becomes a reel, a blog post, 3 tweets, and a LinkedIn carousel. Right? ...Right?
questions.tooltip: Gary Vee's team turns 1 keynote into 64 pieces of content. You don't need a team of 12 to do this. You need a pipeline. One workflow. Zero interns harmed.

options.label: No — each platform gets original content
options.subtitle: You beautiful, exhausted human

questions.text: Have you used AI for content creation?
questions.subtext: ChatGPT counts. Screaming at it also counts.
questions.tooltip: 92% of creators have 'tried' AI. 8% have actually built it into their workflow. The 8% produce 5x more content in half the time. The 92% are still writing prompts that say 'act as a social media expert.'

options.label: Never touched it
options.subtitle: You hand-write your captions in calligraphy, don't you

options.label: Multiple AI tools in my workflow
options.subtitle: Caption gen, image gen, scheduling

options.label: Built a full AI content pipeline
options.subtitle: Are you hiring?

questions.text: What would you invest to cut your content time in half?
questions.subtext: Same output, half the hours. What's that worth?
questions.tooltip: If you spend 20 hours/week on content and your time is worth $100/hr, that's $104,000/year on content production alone. Cutting that in half saves $52,000. Or, you know, you could just keep doing it manually. Your therapist needs the business.

options.label: Whatever gets me my time back
options.subtitle: Now we're talking

results.summary: Every piece of content is a one-off effort. No templates, no automation, no repurposing. You're spending hours on what should take minutes. The good news: you have the biggest upside potential of anyone taking this quiz.
results.recommendation: Start with the fundamentals. TwinGen walks you through building an AI content pipeline from scratch — from idea generation to publish-ready content in minutes, not hours.
